source_prompt: Create a production game PBR BASE COLOR texture, square 4096x4096, seamless tileable, orthographic front view of an immense 91.44 by 91.44 metre arid blasted road-cut rock face. Reference images 1 and 2 show same El Paso angular fractured tan/rust/gray rock under overexposed sun and deep shadow: synthesize original rock matching their geological appearance with balanced exposure and neutral diffuse albedo. Entire image filled with rock, all edges continue seamlessly. Many scales of natural angular fractures, tilted blocky joints, thin sharp chips, crisp granular mineral detail, irregular broad patches of pale beige stone, muted rust and neutral gray. Large nonuniform fracture structures, small exceptionally sharp detailed fractured stone. Not horizontal bedded limestone, not rounded cobbles, not cellular foam. UNLIT albedo: no directional illumination, no cast shadow, no specular, no baked AO or dark gradient. No terrain silhouette, sky, road, cars, vegetation, text, UI, watermark or borders. Output a real detailed 4K texture, not a blurry upscaled image.
detail_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this low-resolution arid road-cut stone texture crop. Perform faithful generative super-resolution and artifact restoration. Return a single square highest-resolution detailed texture crop. Preserve EXACT composition, all tilted angular fractures, broken blocks, mineral patches and tan/rust/gray regions in identical normalized positions, including border features. No zoom, crop, perspective, rotation or rearrangement. Replace soft mottling with photographic fine fractured mineral detail: tiny sharp chips, thin fissures, crisp angular flakes and natural grain. No rounded cellular foam, no horizontal limestone bedding, no uniform artificial noise, no additional broad cracks. Flat diffuse albedo color, no new cast shadows/specular, no text/borders/vegetation. This crop is one overlapping portion of a coherent atlas; strict composition preservation is essential.
